frozen_note: Set frozen=true and record the commit SHA here BEFORE the first model run. Not yet frozen — fields may still change during review.

tasks.brief: Build a small signed-in task list: email sign-in, create/edit/delete a task, tasks are private per user.

checks: sign-in required before any task is visible
a second user cannot see the first user's tasks
create+edit+delete each persist across reload

tasks.brief: Add a 'mark done' toggle and a done/active filter to the existing task list.

checks: toggle persists per task
filter shows only matching tasks
no existing task-privacy check regresses

tasks.brief: The build was interrupted mid-feature; resume and finish without duplicating tasks.

checks: no duplicate task rows after resume
the verified checkpoint before interruption is intact
final app passes the crud-1 checks

tasks.brief: Build a note-taking app that works offline: notes save locally and sync when back online.

checks: a note created offline survives reload offline
it appears after reconnect
no data loss on an offline→online transition

tasks.brief: Add an offline/online indicator and a 'last synced' time to the note app.

checks: indicator reflects real connection state, not a timer
last-synced updates only on a real sync
offline note-save still works

tasks.brief: A sync conflict left two versions of a note; resume and resolve without losing either.

checks: neither note version is silently dropped
the user is shown the conflict
resolution persists across reload

tasks.brief: Build an app that summarizes a pasted article via a model call, with a loading and an error state.

checks: a summary renders for valid input
the error state shows on a failed call (never a blank/forever-spinner)
no API key is exposed to the client

tasks.brief: Add a copy-to-clipboard button and a character count to the summary output.

checks: copy places the summary on the clipboard
count matches the rendered summary
the error/loading states still work

tasks.brief: The model call was timing out and the build stalled; resume with a bounded timeout + retry.

checks: a slow call now fails to the error state within a bounded time
no unbounded hang
a transient failure is retried a bounded number of times

tasks.brief: Import an existing small repo and get it building/previewing without changing its public behavior.

checks: the imported app previews
its existing routes still behave the same
no committed secret is introduced

tasks.brief: Add one small feature to the imported repo in its own style/conventions.

checks: the feature works
it matches the repo's existing patterns
no unrelated file is rewritten

tasks.brief: The import half-applied and left the tree dirty; resume to a clean, building state.

checks: the working tree ends clean
the app builds
no original repo history or file is destroyed
